note: Round 4 of land step 2a (#190, part of #179), the one extra round the owner allowed on the PR to fix B1, which both round-3 verifiers failed fad8b86 on: a quote opened after a list marker or an indent ("- > x", "1. > x", "- x" then a blank line and "    > x") did not count as a quote, so a /land on the next line read as the owner's land and lifted a /hold. inQuote now opens a quote at a > after any indent and list markers, and reads a list marker only with a space or tab after it, as CommonMark does. The brief's one-line fix skipped the holdLine character set, which would also hold a plain /land after "- -> moved" or "3 > 2"; the arrowAndComparisonOpenNoQuote fixture pins the difference. Every line the old inQuote took as a quote start still is one, so no earlier hold weakens. 91 -> 97 kernel fixtures; speech-test.sh 39/0 and land-test.sh 55/0. Four mutants were each caught at build: the old inQuote (4 hold fixtures fail), the brief's version and a bullet without a space (the arrow fixture fails), and no ordered marker (orderedListQuoteHoldsALand fails). iterations and wall_min are estimates; the mutants' build errors were intended and are not counted.
